derivation.source_kind: Persisted actual D3 model HTTP request bodies, response records, immutable Request/decision, discovery Result and final Run.
derivation.byte_preservation: responses[*].request_file.utf8_text and response_file.utf8_text re-encode as UTF-8 to the exact recorded file bytes and sha256; these are bodies/response records, with no transport headers or credentials. The second response entry also preserves its actually sent delivery snapshot sidecar as delivery_file.utf8_text with its own file SHA; this is not a newly built snapshot.
derivation.parsed_objects: request, run_state, accepted_plan, discover_result, proposal and raw_content are parsed/extracted copies, not original file-byte representations. No original records were modified.
derivation.projection: sent_request_projection and sent_delivery_goal_refs are decoded actual sent context fields using tests.unit.test_decision_purpose_capacity.decoded (tests.unit.test_context.payload), without consulting Store.
derivation.run_time_boundary: run_state is the final persisted Run after two model settlements and BudgetExceeded, not a pre-second-HTTP snapshot. Each sent_request_projection retains the actually sent cumulative_usage/remaining.
derivation.cost_boundary: The third/correction HTTP was never sent. Any reconstructed correction size is an offline calculation, not a captured request or new expense.
derivation.omitted: Other registered files and the complete original scientific JSON remain at source paths with hashes; the fixture copies only the relevant structural shape/value.
